intro.title: Select Your Freehub Body
intro.body: A comprehensive guide to matching your freehub with your drivetrain cassettes (Shimano, SRAM, Campagnolo).

guideIntro.title: How to choose the right freehub
guideIntro.body: Follow these steps before choosing a wheelset freehub. The cassette standard and smallest cog are more important than the rear derailleur brand.

step1.title: Identify the drivetrain brand
step1.body: Choose the brand printed on the cassette or groupset, such as Shimano, SRAM, Campagnolo, L-TWOO, SENSAH, microSHIFT, SUNSHINE, ZTTO or Wheeltop.

step2.title: Choose the cassette specification
step2.body: Match the speed and tooth range, especially the smallest cog: 10T, 11T or 9T. The smallest cog determines which freehub standards can physically fit.

step3.title: Read the result
step3.body: Check the recommended freehub, spacer or adapter requirement, and the mechanical note before selecting a wheelset configuration.

guideIntro.identifyTitle: Where to find the cassette information
guideIntro.identifyBody: Look for the brand, model, speed and tooth range stamped on the back of the cassette or lockring, or printed on the cassette packaging. The engraving may be small and difficult to read.
guideIntro.photoTitle: If the marking is difficult to read
guideIntro.photoBody: Take a clear photo of the cassette from the side and rear, including the lockring and largest cog. Support can help identify the specification before you choose a freehub.

microSpline.caption: For MTB 12-Speed
microSpline.name: Micro Spline (MS)
microSpline.body: Deore M6100, XT M8100, XTR M9100

cheatsheet.microSpline: MS (Micro Spline): Necessary for Shimano 12-speed MTB cassettes (10T start). Not backward compatible.
cheatsheet.hyperglide: HG (HyperGlide): The gold standard for decades. Fits 8-11sp MTB and 8-12sp Road cassettes. Note: Road 11sp HG freehubs are longer; require a 1.85mm spacer for MTB cassettes.

cheatsheet.xd: XD: Compact design for MTB cassettes with a 10T small cog.
cheatsheet.xdr: XDR: Road version of XD, 1.85mm longer. Can run XD cassettes with a 1.85mm spacer. Designed for 12-speed AXS road groups.

cheatsheet.n3w: N3W: The future standard. Native for Ekar 13sp. Fits older 10-12sp cassettes with an adapter.
cheatsheet.classic: Classic: The traditional spline for Super Record, Record, Chorus (11/12sp).

seo.title: Bicycle Freehub Body Compatibility Guide: HG-11, Micro Spline, XD, XDR and N3W
seo.description: Check Shimano, SRAM, Campagnolo and third-party cassette compatibility, 1.85 mm spacer requirements, and mechanical fitment rules before choosing a wheelset freehub body.
seo.howToName: How to verify a bicycle cassette and freehub body fit
seo.howToStep1Text: Confirm the cassette brand, speed, smallest cog and largest cog from the cassette label or manufacturer specification.
seo.howToStep2Text: Use the compatibility matrix to match HG-11, HG, Micro Spline, XD, XDR, N3W or Campagnolo Classic to the cassette.
seo.howToStep3Name: Install the required spacer or adapter
seo.howToStep3Text: Install the specified spacer at the freehub inner base, or use the AC21-N3W adapter sleeve and extended lockring when the rule requires it.
